brief:
A war-damaged residential building collapsed in Gaza, killing 21 Palestinians including 12 children and 5 women, the Palestinian Centre for Human Rights reported. The structure had sustained damage in a previous Israeli bombardment. Rescue teams pulled 35 people alive from the rubble after hours of search operations, while 45 others were injured, 10 with serious wounds.

Approximately 2,000 inhabited buildings remain severely damaged across Gaza, according to the centre.
dek: In yet another humanitarian catastrophe, a residential building that had already sustained damage in a previous Israeli bombardment collapsed, killing 21 Palestinians, including 12 children and 5 women, and injuring 45 others, 10 of whom reportedly sustained serious injuries. After hours of continuous search and rescue efforts, rescue teams managed to pull 35 people alive…
title: Building collapse in Gaza kills 21, including 12 children and 5 women
